title: Post-merge resilience: diverged local main from unpushed pre-branch commit leaves cycle half-done
description: When an unpushed commit sits on local main before a feature branch squash-merges, the squash recreates that content at a new SHA and local main diverges from origin/main; the sidecar post-merge git pull then refuses (pull-failed), leaving the cycle half-done (consumes merge-watch, needs manual reset+close+tag+prune). Seen in CAM-152 post-merge. Harden the merge-watch/ship path to detect a diverged local main and either auto-recover (reset --hard origin/main when content is subsumed) or fail loudly with the runbook step, instead of silently wedging the cycle.
